cases.explain: The preposition "из" (from) always governs the genitive.

cases.translation: The Lord is sending me to Bethel.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" with motion uses the accusative.
The verb "оставлю" (will leave) governs the accusative.

cases.sentence: Они оба переправились по сухой ___ через Иордан.
cases.explain: The preposition "по" (on) with location uses the prepositional.

cases.sentence: Дай мне унаследовать твой дух в двойной ___.
cases.translation: Give me a double portion of your spirit.
cases.explain: The phrase "в двойной мере" uses the prepositional.

cases.sentence: Если ты увидишь, то случится по-___.
cases.translation: If you see, it shall be so for you.
cases.explain: The phrase "по-твому" uses the dative case.

cases.sentence: Огненная колесница разлучила их, и Илия вознесся на ___.
cases.translation: Elijah was taken up to heaven.
cases.explain: The preposition "на" with motion uses the accusative.

cases.sentence: Отец мой, отец мой, колесница и конница ___!
cases.translation: My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: "of the land".

reading.ru: Илия сказал Елисею, прошу, останься здесь, Господь посылает меня в Вифиль.
reading.question: What did Elijah ask Elisha to do?
options: To stay while he went to Bethel
reading.correct: To stay while he went to Bethel
reading.explain: Elijah asked Elisha to wait as the Lord was sending him to Bethel.

reading.ru: Но Елисей сказал, верно, как и то, что жив Господь, я не оставлю тебя.
reading.question: How did Elisha respond?
options: He refused to leave Elijah, swearing by the living Lord
He asked to go home first
reading.correct: He refused to leave Elijah, swearing by the living Lord
reading.explain: Elisha made a solemn oath that he would not leave Elijah.

reading.ru: Пятьдесят человек из учеников пророческих пришли и встали поодаль напротив них.
reading.question: Who watched Elijah and Elisha?
options: Fifty sons of the prophets watched from a distance
reading.correct: Fifty sons of the prophets watched from a distance
reading.explain: Fifty of the sons of the prophets came and stood at a distance facing them.

reading.ru: Внезапно явились огненная колесница и огненные кони, разлучили их, и Илия вознесся в вихре на небо.
reading.question: What happened to Elijah at the Jordan?
options: A chariot of fire appeared and he was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind
He crossed the Jordan and disappeared
He was killed by the army
He was taken to Mount Sinai
reading.correct: A chariot of fire appeared and he was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind
reading.explain: A chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared, separated them, and Elijah was taken up in a whirlwind.

reading.ru: И Елисей смотрел на это и кричал, отец мой, отец мой, колесница и конница Израиля!
reading.question: What did Elisha cry out?
options: My father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!
reading.correct: My father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!
reading.explain: Elisha cried out "My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"

reading.ru: Жители города сказали Елисею, Господин, этот город расположен хорошо, но вода тут плохая, и земля бесплодна.
reading.question: What problem did the city have?
options: The water was bad and the land was barren
reading.correct: The water was bad and the land was barren
reading.explain: The men of Jericho said the city was well-situated but the water was bad and the land unfruitful.
